column1: # Rebuildable projections only; never register authoritative rows here.
# Each row names its table, logical Derived kind, owning module, authoritative
# source rows, schema version and the owner's rebuild SQL. Maintain the
# projection in the same transaction as its authoritative rows.
# At startup the owner calls derived::ensure with all owned schema objects.
# Missing objects, changed definitions or any version mismatch drop and rebuild
# the projection from the named source rows; these never reject an old cache.
# Keep object names stable, or pass retired names so recovery removes them too.
